name: bag-of-rocks
description: Blind synthetic UX walkthroughs by a dense, nervous persona, with an annotated evidence filmstrip.

interface.longDescription: Give an agent a goal without the route. A blind tester persona works through your rendered app, and a reviewer compares its path with the intended one in an annotated screenshot filmstrip.
defaultPrompt: Run a bag-of-rocks walkthrough: change my mailing address on our staging site, without saving.
Use bag-of-rocks to retest the checkout fix on localhost with the full-bag preset.
Have a confused first-time user try to book a room on our local site and show me where they got stuck.
